en: Was that... Could that have actually{SAUT}happened to Hikari in the past?
Yeah. I heard the words "class{SAUT}assembly," so it must've been back{SAUT}when she was in elementary school.
What's right, and what's wrong, huh?
It is indeed difficult to judge what is{SAUT}right or wrong when you lack definite{SAUT}rules...{PAGE}But, that situation just now―that was{SAUT}no different from a dictatorship.
What the teacher says is absolute, eh?{SAUT}No effin' way I'm buyin' THAT one!
All they did was push their own selfish{SAUT}decisions on others, just because they{SAUT}were in the majority!
Teachers aren't allies of the weak.{SAUT}There are no such things as heroes...
Oh, is that Hikari-san from the past?
The power to make people do what{SAUT}they're told... My teacher forced me{SAUT}to apologize using that power...
...That's right. My teacher wasn't a hero{SAUT}at all.
Wait, what the―Another Hikari-chan?{SAUT}Is she the real one!?
There's no question―that one's real!
Hikarin, you're safe! I'm going to{SAUT}rescue you this instant!
Just wait a sec. Both of them are acting{SAUT}sorta weird...
Why did you defy the teacher? You knew{SAUT}you'd only get in more trouble...

Well... It's because of all the heroes I've{SAUT}seen in movies...{PAGE}They were strong, and they did the right{SAUT}thing! They helped the weak!{PAGE}But, I said I was sorry... All because my{SAUT}teacher decided that I was wrong.
The words that I wanted to say weren't{SAUT}"I'm sorry"...{PAGE}The truth is... what I really wanted to{SAUT}say to her was―
Hikari-san... Are you still defying me!?
Shiratori-san... Are you still defying me!?
You refused to listen to me...{PAGE}You didn't even try to understand. You{SAUT}might be a teacher, but you're wrong!
Talking back to a teacher...
...Uuuuuuunaaaaaacceptabllllle!
*shriek* Noooo!
Hikari-chan! Look out!
Tch, we gotta save her!
